name: Qwen-Image 2.1
tagline: The most capable free image model, with excellent text inside pictures.
strengths: Follows long, detailed prompts and writes words inside the picture correctly, in English and Chinese. Strong at people, scenes, posters and cards. Large: use a lower quant if your card is small.

name: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo
tagline: Qwen-Image 2.1 in about 4 steps.
strengths: Nearly the quality of Qwen-Image 2.1 in a fraction of the time. A good everyday choice if you have the memory.

name: Z-Image Turbo
tagline: Fast, photo-real, and happy on small graphics cards.
strengths: Very good photos of people and places in 8 steps, and it fits cards with as little as 4 GB. One of the best picks for speed and quality together.

name: Z-Image (full)
tagline: Z-Image with more control and variety.
strengths: The full model behind Z-Image Turbo: more varied and easier to steer, but needs more steps.

name: ERNIE-Image Turbo
tagline: Quick, clean pictures with readable text.
strengths: Good at posters, signs and layouts with words. Runs on cards with 4 GB.

name: ERNIE-Image
tagline: The full ERNIE-Image model.
strengths: Slower than the Turbo version with a little more detail and control.

name: FLUX.1 dev
tagline: The reference model for high-quality images.
strengths: Excellent detail, anatomy and prompt following. Licence is non-commercial.

name: FLUX.1 schnell
tagline: The best free-for-everything image model of its generation: 4 steps, Apache licence.
strengths: Clean detail, follows long prompts, and you may sell what you make.

name: Chroma
tagline: A flexible FLUX-based model with a wide range of styles.
strengths: Open, uncensored-leaning model with very varied styles from anime to photo. Needs more steps than FLUX.1 schnell.

name: Stable Diffusion 1.5
tagline: The classic. Runs almost anywhere.
strengths: Small and quick, works on 4 GB cards, with thousands of styles made for it. Weaker at hands, text and long prompts.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large
tagline: Stability AI's large model with good text and variety.
strengths: Strong, varied pictures and decent text. Large; low quants fit smaller cards.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium
tagline: Good text in images and a small file size.
strengths: Better than older Stable Diffusion at words inside pictures and following prompts.
